Description: Player is pulled into a sealed obsidian arena with a freshly spawned Wither. Return on Wither death or player death.
Implementation Notes: Save return pos + inventory snapshot. Decide keep-inventory rules for sandbox deaths.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Spawn a vanilla Wither in the middle.

Description: Dark sculk cavern with a dormant Warden. Sneak to the exit portal without waking it.
Implementation Notes: Apply Darkness; place sculk shriekers along the obvious path.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. The Warden, sculk sensors and shriekers are all vanilla.

Description: Warning rumble and a fiery particle trail, then a meteor slams down within 8 blocks: big explosion, magma and fire crater.
Implementation Notes: Cap explosion power in config; respect spawn protection and claim mods.

Description: 20-40 primed TNT rain from the sky in a 12-block radius over 10 seconds.
Implementation Notes: Count and radius configurable. Stagger spawns to limit lag.

Description: Three charged creepers spawn in a ring around the player with a lightning flash.
Implementation Notes: Spawn 4-5 blocks out so the player has a moment to react.

Description: Player stands on one block above the void; surrounding blocks crumble. Survive 30 seconds and an exit portal appears.
Implementation Notes: Give a few sandbox-only blocks to build with.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Crumbling: a server tick task removes a random edge block every 10 ticks.

Description: Sealed glass box. Lava rises one block every 4 seconds. One hidden block in the walls is breakable.
Implementation Notes: Mark the weak block with subtle cracked texture.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Rising lava: a tick task fills one layer of lava every 80 ticks.

Description: Current armor is dropped at the player's feet and replaced with leather armor bearing Curse of Binding and negative armor modifiers.
Implementation Notes: Never delete gear - drop it so it can be recovered.

Description: All experience levels are drained, orbs visibly spiraling into the block and vanishing.
The entire inventory sprays out in all directions at high velocity.
Implementation Notes: Extend item despawn timer to ~10 min for fairness.

Description: Player is launched ~150 blocks straight up with no slow fall.
Implementation Notes: Water bucket clutch is the counterplay.

Description: Instant thunderstorm. Lightning strikes the player's position every 2 seconds for 20 seconds - keep moving to dodge.
Implementation Notes: Fire spread from lightning; config to disable fire.

Description: Flooded prismarine chamber with two Elder Guardians. Mining Fatigue III applied on arrival.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Elder Guardians are vanilla and apply Mining Fatigue on their own.

Description: A sphere of radius 7 under the player is deleted with no drops. The player falls in.
Implementation Notes: Skip bedrock and tile entities; cap depth.

Description: Player receives Bad Omen V. Raid starts in the nearest village, or a pillager war party spawns if none.
Dropped into a fortress corridor with blazes and wither skeletons. Fight to the exit.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Spawn vanilla blazes and wither skeletons from a list of positions saved with the structure.

Description: Health set to half a heart. Survive 60 seconds and receive a Legendary roll.
Implementation Notes: Good 'redemption' effect; announce rules on screen.

Description: For 5 minutes every block the player breaks has a 25% chance to spawn silverfish or a small explosion.
A buffed Wither with extra health and minions in a ruined arena. Huge loot chest if beaten.
Implementation Notes: Pairs with a high reward to make it feel fair.
Build Path (easiest): No new entity: spawn a vanilla Wither, add permanent attribute modifiers (max_health x2, armor +6) and heal it to full. A tick task spawns 2 wither skeletons every 20 seconds.

Description: Three ravagers with evoker riders charge the player.
A countdown boss bar appears. In 30 seconds, a large explosion occurs where the block was broken.
Implementation Notes: Player can run; good for 'oh no' moments.
Build Path (easiest): Use a vanilla ServerBossEvent for the countdown bar, then level.explode() when it runs out.

Description: Anvils fall around and onto the player for 8 seconds.
Implementation Notes: Anvils land as blocks; optionally remove after 30s.

Description: 8-12 zombies with mixed armor spawn around the player.
Implementation Notes: Scale count with how negative the luck is.

Description: Four skeletons appear on temporary cobblestone pillars around the player.
A creeper appears directly behind the player, already hissing.
The lucky block itself explodes at power 3.
Player is encased in obsidian with a creeper. Cage dissolves after 30 seconds.
Cobwebs fill the area and cave spiders drop in.
Stone in a 6-block radius is converted to infested stone.
Lava source placed above the player flows down over them.
Implementation Notes: Auto-remove source after 15s to limit spread.

Description: Three witches spawn in a triangle, cackling.
Six fire-immune phantoms dive at the player, even in daylight.
Build Path (easiest): Vanilla phantoms with infinite Fire Resistance so they survive daylight. They will still look like they're burning, which fits.

Description: Held item loses 50% of its remaining durability.
Food set to 1 and Hunger III for 60 seconds.
A lingering poison cloud bursts from the block.
Hedge maze under Blindness with zombies roaming. Find the exit portal.
Build Path (easiest): Make 3-5 maze layouts as .nbt structures and pick one at random. That's much easier than generating mazes in code.

Description: Survive three waves of increasingly tough mobs in an enclosed arena.
Implementation Notes: Reward small loot at end to soften.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Waves: a tick task spawns the next list of vanilla mobs once the current wave is dead.

Description: Stranded on a tiny floating island. Build a bridge to the exit with the scraps provided.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it.

Description: A ravager with a pillager rider barrels toward the player.
A ghast spawns high overhead and starts shooting fireballs.
Implementation Notes: Fireballs grief terrain; disable via config.

Description: Player receives a ticking Hot Potato. It explodes in 15 seconds wherever it is - in the inventory or thrown.
Build Path (easiest): Custom item, not an entity. Store a countdown in a data component and tick it in inventoryTick(). Handle the dropped case in the ItemEntity tick hook (NeoForge: onEntityItemUpdate; Fabric: a small mixin or tracking the tossed entity). Explode at whoever is holding it, or wherever it is lying.

Description: A shower of diamonds that turn into silverfish when picked up.
Hotbar and inventory are randomly rearranged.
A giant slime spawns and splits into many smaller ones.
Dropped into a deep flooded pit with drowned and tridents. Swim up to exit.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Drowned spawn with tridents set in their main-hand slot.

Description: Five angry endermen spawn already aggroed.
Levitation for 10 seconds, then Slowness and no Slow Falling as the player drops.
For 3 minutes all hostile mobs within 48 blocks target the player.
A flock of chickens appears and each explodes 3 seconds later.
TNT hiss, boom sound and smoke particles - but nothing happens.
Chat announces the player was slain by a Lucky Block. They're fine.
Several baby zombie chicken jockeys spawn.
A bee nest pops out and the bees are immediately angry.
A column of sand/gravel falls onto the player's head.
Slowness II and Mining Fatigue II for 60 seconds.
Nausea and Weakness for 30 seconds.
Player is teleported to a random safe spot up to 50 blocks away.
A 2x2 hole up to 10 blocks deep opens beneath the player.
Implementation Notes: 2x2 under where the player stands, so a player between blocks still falls. Natural ground only.

Description: An invisible creeper spawns nearby. Listen for the hiss.
Implementation Notes: Glowing on fuse start for fairness.
Build Path (easiest): Vanilla creeper with Invisibility. A tick check adds Glowing once its fuse starts (getSwellDir() > 0) so players can react.

Description: The held item is flung 10 blocks away.
A carved pumpkin with Curse of Binding is stuck on the player's head for 60 seconds.
Implementation Notes: Remove automatically after timer; drop their helmet.

Description: A stack of rotten flesh and poisonous potatoes.
Four vexes zip out of the block.
A cluster of endermites crawls out.
Five cave spiders swarm the player.
Time instantly set to night.
Implementation Notes: Server-wide; disable on multiplayer by default.

Description: Lightning strikes the player once.
Fire erupts in a ring around the player.
Player is encased in ice that melts over 15 seconds.
For 60 seconds the player randomly drops their held item.
For 60 seconds armor randomly unequips into the inventory.
Black ink particles and Blindness for 5 seconds.
The block reappears in place, worse luck. Breaking it again rerolls at luck -20.
Build Path (easiest): Place the lucky block again with its luck set to -20 and a chain counter in its block entity.

Description: A pillager 'tax collector' takes 25% of the player's emeralds/gold and flees. Kill him to get it back.
Build Path (easiest): No new entity: vanilla Pillager with a custom name. Move the stolen items into its persistent data and drop them on death. A tick task every 10 ticks sends it away from the player with getNavigation().moveTo(). It despawns after 60 seconds, taking the loot with it.

Description: The block breaks with a sad little 'poof'.
Implementation Notes: Keep weight high so the pool isn't always eventful.

Description: A random fortune/hint appears in chat, sometimes a real tip about the mod.
A random assortment of passive animals appears.
A sheep named jeb_ appears, cycling colors.
A burst of fireworks erupts around the player.
A random stack of decorative building blocks.
Player swaps places with the nearest mob.
Weather cycles to a random state.
Pigs fall from the sky (with slow falling, they're fine).
A random positive or negative effect for 30 seconds.
Player shrinks to half size or grows to double for 60 seconds.
Build Path (easiest): Vanilla generic.scale attribute modifier (1.20.5+), removed after 60 seconds.

Description: Heads or tails on screen. Heads rerolls at +30, tails at -30.
Implementation Notes: Good way to keep neutrals spicy.
Build Path (easiest): Show the result with a vanilla title/subtitle, then reroll.

Description: Two more lucky blocks pop up nearby with random luck from -20 to +20.
A wandering trader and llamas show up.
Two snow golems spawn to follow the player around.
Build Path (easiest): Vanilla snow golems with their UUIDs tracked. A tick task every 20 ticks calls getNavigation().moveTo(player) if they're more than 6 blocks away, for 5 minutes. Snow golems already attack hostile mobs.

Description: Floor around the player flashes colored glass with music for 15 seconds.
Llamas appear and spit at the player for no damage.
A loud ghast scream and nothing else.
A jukebox appears playing a random disc.
A treasure map pointing to a nearby buried chest.
All nearby mobs are swapped for random other mobs of the same hostility.
The clock jumps forward 6000 ticks.
A tame parrot lands on the player's shoulder.
The block reappears and vanishes when hit, three times, then breaks normally into a fresh roll.
16-32 iron ingots burst out.
16-32 gold ingots.
Bread, cooked steak, golden carrots and a cake.
Full set of iron tools.
A fountain of XP orbs worth ~10 levels.
Healing, Speed and Night Vision potions.
Three tamed wolves with collars.
A tamed, saddled horse with good stats.
One random enchanted book.
Speed II and Haste II for 3 minutes.
16-32 emeralds.
Redstone, lapis, coal and copper in small stacks.
An iron golem that follows and protects the player for 10 minutes.
Build Path (easiest): Vanilla iron golem with setPlayerCreated(true). Same follow approach as Snow Golem Escort: every 20 ticks, moveTo(player) if more than 8 blocks away; stop after 10 minutes.

Description: A chest filled from the simple dungeon loot table.
Implementation Notes: Use vanilla loot tables for easy datapack overrides.

Description: Stacks of logs, stone bricks and glass.
Bone meal pulse: flowers and grass bloom in a radius, saplings grow.
Nearby ores glow through walls for 60 seconds.
Implementation Notes: Uses glowing Block Display entities; no client rendering code.
Build Path (easiest): No client code: spawn vanilla Block Display entities copying each ore block within 16 blocks, with setGlowingTag(true), and remove them after 60 seconds. The glow shows through walls. Other players see it too.

Description: Every lucky block within 64 blocks, disguised ones too, glows through walls for two minutes, coloured by its luck.
Implementation Notes: Requested addition. Like Ore Vision; also hints at each block's luck.
Build Path (easiest): Glowing Block Display entities like Ore Vision's, found through the loaded chunks' block entities (not a block scan), up to 100, glow colour from the luck.

Description: Iron pickaxe with Fortune II and Efficiency II.
Fishing rod with Luck of the Sea III and Lure II.
8 ender pearls.
Name tags, leads and a saddle.
Seeds, carrots, potatoes, beetroot and bone meal.
Bow with Power II and 64 arrows.
An allay that collects items for the player.
Regeneration and full food bar.
3 golden apples.
A tamed cat that scares creepers.
Two lucky blocks appear with luck +20 to +50.
Drops one random item that can be crafted or found in the world, from vanilla or any installed mod. Stackable items come as a small stack.
Implementation Notes: Rebuild the list after every datapack reload.
Build Path (easiest): Build an allowlist when the server starts and after /reload, and cache it. 1) Recipes: add the result item of every recipe in the RecipeManager. This covers modded recipe types too. On 1.21.2+, read the result from the recipe's display instead of getResultItem(). 2) World loot: for every chest, entity, fishing, archaeology and gameplay loot table, encode it to JSON with LootTable.DIRECT_CODEC and collect the "name" of each minecraft:item entry. No access transformers needed. 3) Natural blocks: add the drops of blocks in shared tags such as c:ores, minecraft:logs, minecraft:leaves, minecraft:flowers, minecraft:dirt, minecraft:sand and minecraft:base_stone_overworld. Don't use all block loot tables: many mods' creative blocks drop themselves. Finally, remove anything in the #yourmod:lucky_blacklist tag.

Description: 8-16 diamonds.
Full diamond armor with Protection II.
Diamond sword with Sharpness III and Looting II.
One Totem of Undying.
One enchanted golden apple.
~30 levels of XP.
A shulker box filled with mixed good loot.
Trident with Loyalty II.
Teleport into a gold-lined vault with loot chests. 60 seconds to grab what you can.
Implementation Notes: Loot carried back; timer boss bar.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Timer is a vanilla boss bar; teleport the player back when it ends.

Description: Parkour course with a big reward chest at the end. Falling returns you home with nothing.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Falling below a set Y sends the player back without the reward.

Description: Redstone/lever puzzle room. Solve it to open the reward chamber.
Build Path (easiest): Build the puzzle with vanilla redstone, levers and doors inside the .nbt. The game handles the logic for you.

Description: Iron blocks for a 1-tier beacon pyramid.
Enchanted book: Mending.
Strength II, Regeneration II and Resistance II for 5 minutes.
Gold ingots and nuggets rain down for 10 seconds.
Three lucky blocks appear with luck +40 to +80.
4 ancient debris.
Fast horse with diamond horse armor.
Two villagers with strong locked trades.
Bow with Power VI, Punch II, Infinity and Flame (past vanilla's limits).
Hero of the Village V for 20 minutes.
Hostile mobs won't spawn within 32 blocks for 10 minutes.
Build Path (easiest): Cancel hostile mob spawns within 32 blocks of the player using the loader's spawn-check event (NeoForge: MobSpawnEvent.PositionCheck).

Description: Heart of the Sea and nautilus shells for a conduit.
Full netherite armor with Protection VI and Unbreaking V (past vanilla's limits).
Netherite sword with Sharpness VII, Looting IV, Fire Aspect III, Mending (past vanilla's limits).
Elytra with Unbreaking V and 64 rockets.
Beacon plus enough iron blocks for a full pyramid.
One nether star.
Tropical island scattered with loot chests. 3 minutes to explore.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it.

Description: Optional prompt: accept a boss arena challenge for a massive reward, or decline and get a smaller one.
Build Path (easiest): Build the room in a creative test world, save it with a Structure Block to .nbt, ship it in data/<modid>/structure/, and place it in the sandbox dimension with StructureTemplate.placeInWorld. Spawn the vanilla mobs after placing it. Ask with clickable chat text: accept/decline buttons that run hidden /luckyblock commands.

Description: Permanently +1 max heart.
Implementation Notes: Cap total bonus hearts in config.
Build Path (easiest): Permanent vanilla attribute modifier on max_health with a fixed id; add to its amount each time. Cap it in config.

Description: A GUI offers three Legendary items. Pick one.
Build Path (easiest): Open a vanilla 9x1 chest menu (SimpleMenuProvider plus a small ChestMenu subclass) showing 3 items. Override clicked(): give the chosen item and close. Block every other click.

Description: Ten lucky blocks erupt with luck +60 to +100.
Implementation Notes: Limit chains so they can't loop forever.

Description: One-time auto-revive on death, with fire burst.
Build Path (easiest): A boolean data attachment on the player. On the death event, if it's true: cancel the death, set health to 50%, play the totem animation, clear the flag.

Description: Saturation and Regeneration for 10 minutes.
Enchanting table, 15 bookshelves and lapis.
Netherite pickaxe with Efficiency VII, Fortune IV, Unbreaking V, Mending (past vanilla's limits).
A pillar of diamond blocks rises from the ground.
Implementation Notes: Benign world change; still places blocks.

Description: A small tame dragon pet that walks with the player and fights mobs, like a wolf. Ground-only, no flight.
Build Path (easiest): Re-skin the wolf. class DragonHatchling extends Wolf keeps taming, sit, follow-owner and attack-target goals as they are. Register the EntityType and use Wolf.createAttributes() with more health and damage. Spawn it already tamed: tame(player). Model in Blockbench (Modded Entity → export Java model), renderer extends MobRenderer. Write your own renderer instead of WolfRenderer so the wolf variant/collar/armor layers aren't drawn. Copy setupAnim from WolfModel for the walk cycle. Return null from getBreedOffspring. Ground-only: flight AI is cut as too difficult.

Description: Five empty shulker boxes in random colors.
4 netherite ingots.
Rolls Mystery Item 3 times: three random items that can be crafted or found in the world, from vanilla or any installed mod.
Implementation Notes: Reuses the Mystery Item list. No rarity filter.
Build Path (easiest): Call the Mystery Item effect 3 times. No extra code beyond Mystery Item.

Description: A chest whose loot table quality scales with the block's luck.
Accept to reroll with luck multiplied by 2 (clamped), or walk away with a small prize.
Build Path (easiest): Clickable chat buttons (accept/walk away) that run hidden commands. No GUI needed.

Description: Spawns a mob from a table weighted by luck: hostile when negative, passive/tame when positive.
Explosion whose power scales from 2 to 6 with how negative the luck is.

One random item with durability (armor and off hand included) drops to its last point. If nothing can wear, the player does: health and hunger to one, and if that last hunger runs out with no food on them, they die.
Implementation Notes: Requested addition (not in the original catalog).
Build Path (easiest): Pick a damageable stack not already at 1 durability and set its damage to max-1. Otherwise set health 1, food 1, saturation 0, Hunger I for 60 s, and track the player: at food 0 with no food item in the inventory, starve them; eating (food 2+) or 5 minutes ends it.

Description: 8-16 Casino Tokens burst out (more the luckier the block).
Implementation Notes: Requested addition: tokens feed the casino.

Description: A casino in the Sandbox: slot machines, roulette, blackjack and a Casino Dealer, with 8 tokens on the house. Leave by the way out just outside the door; winnings come home.
Implementation Notes: Requested addition. Nothing in it can be broken or taken.
Build Path (easiest): A Sandbox room like the others: the casino machines, a Dealer villager, an exit portal outside the door, 10 minutes at most.

Description: 2-4 Piles of Tokens and a few tokens, with the jackpot fanfare.
Three Piglin Brutes, who never zombify, come for the player.
Four shulkers surround the player; their bullets lift you up, and the ground is a long way down.
Three vindicators and a pillager, all after the player.
Three blazes appear around the player, even in the Overworld.
Two breezes, and their wind charges, bounce the player about.
One worn armor piece flies off in a random direction (it can be picked up again). No armor: Weakness II for a minute.
Every few seconds for 30 seconds the player hiccups: a little hop and a burp.
For a minute, every 5 seconds a stack falls out of the backpack (not the hotbar) at the player's feet.
Darkness for 15 seconds, with a heartbeat thumping in the player's ears.
Three pillagers with crossbows, after the player.
Three bogged skeletons with poison arrows.
The hotbar's nine slots are shuffled.
Three pufferfish flop about at the player's feet; they puff up and poison when close.
Levitation II for 3 seconds, then the fall.
One stack of food turns into as much rotten flesh. No food: Hunger II for 30 seconds.
Eight cod, salmon and tropical fish fall from the sky around the player.
Up to eight nearby animals are named Dinnerbone and turn upside down. None about: two upside-down pigs.
An armor stand wearing the player's own head, with a name tag.
A Sniffer egg.
The player glows (visible through walls) for two minutes.
For 20 seconds, doors creak, chests open and something shuffles about nearby. Nothing is there.
The player is spun round to face the other way.
Jump Boost III and Slow Falling for a minute.
Four frogs.
24-40 copper ingots and a spyglass.
32 redstone, 4 repeaters, 2 comparators, 4 pistons, 2 sticky pistons, 2 observers.
Night Vision for 10 minutes and 32 torches.
2 name tags, 4 leads, a saddle and 8 bones.
A turtle shell, two long Water Breathing potions and a long Night Vision potion.
A compass, an empty map, a clock, a boat, a bed and 16 steaks.
A beehive, a campfire, 4 honey bottles, 6 honeycomb and two bees to move in.
A Four-Leaf Clover.
Two random armor trim templates (any mod's too).
A netherite upgrade template and a netherite ingot.
Diamond pickaxe, axe and shovel, each with Efficiency III and Unbreaking III.
48 wind charges and 4 breeze rods.
Six potions: Strength II, Regeneration II, Swiftness II, and long Fire Resistance, Invisibility and Night Vision.
Trident with Loyalty III, Channeling, Impaling VII, Unbreaking V and Mending (past vanilla's limits).
Mace with Density VII, Wind Burst III, Unbreaking V and Mending (past vanilla's limits), and 16 wind charges.
Bad Luck II for 5 minutes (-20 on every lucky block you break, the casino well against you), and a black cat appears nearby.
Implementation Notes: Requested: the vanilla Luck / Bad Luck effects tilt lucky blocks and the casino (PlayerLuck, CasinoLuck).

Description: Bad Luck I for 5 minutes: -10 on every lucky block you break, and the casino a little against you.
Implementation Notes: Requested: the vanilla Luck / Bad Luck effects tilt lucky blocks and the casino (PlayerLuck, CasinoLuck).

Description: Luck I for 5 minutes: +10 on every lucky block you break, and a slight edge at the casino.
Implementation Notes: Requested: the vanilla Luck / Bad Luck effects tilt lucky blocks and the casino (PlayerLuck, CasinoLuck).

Description: Luck II for 5 minutes: +20 on every lucky block you break, and a good edge at the casino. Go gamble.
Implementation Notes: Requested: the vanilla Luck / Bad Luck effects tilt lucky blocks and the casino (PlayerLuck, CasinoLuck).

Description: Tells you the tier of your next lucky block, drawn by that blocks odds, and guarantees it.
Implementation Notes: Requested: luck-system effects (Fortunes, Fate). The omen is saved with the player and used up by their next lucky block.

Description: Your next lucky block is guaranteed Bad (7 in 10) or Very Bad (3 in 10).
Implementation Notes: Requested: luck-system effects (Fortunes, Fate). Insurance still covers it.

Description: The next bad effect a lucky block draws for you never happens. One policy at a time.
Implementation Notes: Requested: luck-system effects (Fortunes, Fate). Applies to lucky-block draws and their redraws, not the admin effect command.

Description: A ticket: hold it in your off hand when breaking a lucky block to choose between two effects.
Implementation Notes: Requested: luck-system effects (Fortunes, RerollMenu). Closing the window without choosing plays one at random.

Description: A named rock with a like and a dislike. It does nothing. Use it to pet it.
A 100-block shaft with five floors, one opening in each, water at the bottom. Medal by floors passed.
Implementation Notes: Requested: skill rooms (SkillRooms). Falls dont hurt in skill rooms.

Description: A winding sky course of packed and blue ice, with turns and gaps. Medal by time.
Honey platforms stepping down through the sky, a slime pad below each gap. Medal by time.
Stone-brick paths that crack and fall away after you step on them, with easy quartz jumps between. Medal by time.
Six floating islands too far to jump, nine pearls. Medal by pearls left.
Implementation Notes: Requested: skill rooms (SkillRooms). Pearls dont hurt in skill rooms.

Description: Climb a 50-block tower by jumps, ladders, vines and scaffolding. Medal by height in 3 minutes.
A coloured dance floor; stand on the called colour before the rest drops away. Ten rounds; medal by rounds survived.
Repeat the sequence of lit pads on their buttons; one longer each round. Medal by sequences repeated.
